import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """date,ships
2025-01-09,37
2025-01-21,38
2025-02-02,60
2025-02-14,42
2025-02-26,42
2025-03-10,37
2025-03-22,46
2025-04-03,26
2025-04-15,34
2025-04-27,33
2025-05-09,37
2025-06-02,51
2025-06-14,41
2025-06-26,33
2025-07-08,42
2025-07-20,60
2025-08-01,27
2025-08-13,41
2025-08-25,39
2025-09-06,56
2025-09-18,48
2025-09-30,37
2025-10-12,47
2025-10-24,42
2025-11-05,42
2025-11-29,51
2025-12-05,43
2025-12-11,49
2025-12-23,45
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_passes(df):
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.8))
    ax.bar(pd.to_datetime(df.date), df.ships, width=6, color="#1f5fd6")
    ax.axhline(df.ships.mean(), ls="--", color="k", lw=1)
    ax.set_title("Ships in the gate at each Sentinel-1 pass, 2025 (19:34 local time, every 12 days)", loc="left", fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_ylabel("ships detected"); ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
    return fig

plot_passes(df)
plt.show()
